h1: Meal Prep Kitchen Reset: What Makes Weeknights Easier
intro: Eight pieces that shorten the distance between getting home and eating. Glass that goes from oven to fridge, one tool that does the chopping, a peeler that makes a bag of carrots a small job instead of a chore. Nothing here is a diet plan. It is the equipment that makes the good weeknight the easier choice.
seo_title: Meal Prep Kitchen Reset: Containers and Tools for Weeknights
seo_description: Eight kitchen pieces for easier weeknights: glass containers, a chopper, a peeler and spice inserts, all verified editor picks from Evergreen House.
list_card_line: Eight kitchen pieces that shorten the distance between getting home and eating something good.

cards.B07JK1LGHQ: Five glass containers that go from the oven to the fridge to the microwave.
cards.B00004OCIU: The peeler that makes a whole bag of carrots a small job instead of a chore.
cards.B081PQTKSZ: A bento box with compartments, so lunch arrives the way it left the kitchen.
cards.B09K7CVJ89: Two four tier inserts that lay the spice jars flat in the drawer, labels up.
cards.B00TO8X0BA: Keeps the greens and the berries going a few days longer than the fridge would.
cards.B0GQGBTPCT: Eight clear bins with lids, for the shelf that has been hiding three open bags.
cards.B0CN9PPZCJ: One chopper that does the dicing, so the knife work stops being the reason you order in.
cards.B08B7GLYZC: Four glass pieces with lids that snap shut, and none of them stain from tomato.
